title: VTA Witness — List — payload
description: A client reads back from its VTA the Verifiable Witness Credentials vta/witness/accept stored for its principal, each with the outcome evidence stored beside it. Every filter is optional and those present are AND-combined.

relationshipDid.description: Only VWCs whose credentialSubject.id is this relationship DID.

witness.description: Only VWCs issued by this witness.

pageSize.description: Maximum entries to return. The VTA MAY return fewer and caps this value.

cursor.description: Continue a previous page. Opaque: a consumer MUST NOT construct or parse one.

Response.title: VTA Witness — List — response payload
Response.description: One entry per stored VWC that matched and that the caller may read. Empty when nothing matched, which is a successful answer, not an error.

witnessings.description: The matching stored VWCs, each with its evidence.

truncated.description: The VTA stopped early. A consumer MUST NOT read a truncated page as a complete account of what is stored.

cursor.description: Pass to the next request to continue. Absent when the page is the last.

StoredWitnessing.title: StoredWitnessing
StoredWitnessing.description: One VWC vta/witness/accept stored, as accept answered it, with the time it was stored. The VWC itself travels once, inside evidence.outcome, under the witness's proof.

credentialId.description: The credential-vault handle the VWC is stored under: the credentialId vta/witness/accept returned.

witness.description: The witness that issued the VWC: its issuer, which is the recipient of evidence.session.

relationshipDid.description: The relationship DID the VWC names as its credentialSubject.id.

vwcDigestMultibase.description: The VWC's digest, as the witness returned it and the VTA checked it at accept: over the RFC 8785 canonicalization of the VWC, proof included.

evidence.description: The outcome evidence stored with the VWC, each document exactly as stored, never re-serialised: `session`, the witness/session document as the VTA built it, and `outcome`, the witness/session/submit #response as received, which carries the VWC. Of whichever version the session was conducted under.
